item.title: Path of Exile 2: Forbidden Rites FAQ
item.description:
Last week, we announced Forbidden Rites, an event league in Path of Exile 2 launching alongside the 0.5.5 patch on September 4th PDT. In this news post, we’ve answered some of the most common questions from our community about the event.

Is Duelist in 0.5.5?
No, Duelist will be released on December 11th when Path of Exile 2 1.0 fully launches.
